document.abstract: The chemical and physical properties of the alloy Inconel are described, with especial reference to the requirements of film processing equipment. Examples of applications of Inconel in motion picture film handling apparatus are given. As a background to the use of Inconel, the more familiar properties and uses of monel metal and pure nickel with photographic solutions are discussed briefly.
